hero.subtitle: Handcrafted arch sofas made from oak and linen dyed in earth tones. Honest, warm, and built to last a lifetime at home.

story.title: Three things we never compromise
story.item1Text: The SOFA TERRA palette draws from terracotta, desert sand and afternoon glow — tones that grow more beautiful with use.
story.item2Text: Every backrest is a hand-bent arch, no sharp corners, embracing your posture and the light of your living room.
story.item3Text: Mortise-and-tenon oak frame, natural latex cushions with replaceable layers. A sofa to pass down, not to replace.

collections.title: Three earth tones, three rhythms of life
collections.subtitle: Each collection is a distinct material palette, chosen by the sunlight and daily rhythms of your family.
collections.c1Desc: Substantial arches, warm terracotta tones, ideal for sunlit apartments.
collections.c2Desc: Textured bouclé surface, low profile, gentle as a morning sand dune.
collections.c3Desc: Deep green balanced by earth tones, round armrests in the Mediterranean garden style.

materials.title: Feel every weave
materials.subtitle: Select a fabric to see its characteristics. The real swatch set will be sent to your home for free.
materials.m1Detail: Coarse-woven Belgian flax, breathable, takes on a warm terracotta tone that endures sunlight.
materials.m2Detail: Textured curled surface, holds shape well, light sand tone opens up small spaces.
materials.m3Detail: Classic pile velvet, deep olive tone, reflects light gently in the evening.
materials.m4Detail: Wool-cotton blend dyed with herbs, raised weave texture, softens with use.

steps.title: From hand sketch to your living room
steps.s1Text: An architect visits your home to measure and understand how your family sits.
steps.s2Text: A set of 40 earth-toned fabric swatches is delivered to your door to see in your own sunlight.
steps.s3Text: Mortise-and-tenon oak frame, craftsmen hand-bend the back arch over 9 days.
steps.s4Text: Delivered and installed within 48h in the city, positioned and cleaned, with care guidance.

testimonials.title: Three years on, still warm
testimonials.t1Quote: The terracotta color is much truer in person. The arch backrest softens the whole apartment — every visitor asks where it's from.
testimonials.t2Quote: Ordered 6 sets for the homestay — after 2 years of central coast sun and wind, the fabric still holds its color. The installation team was impeccable.
testimonials.t3Quote: The swatch set delivered to my home was a huge plus — I compared colors on my balcony in the sun before deciding. Worth every dong.

faqs.title: Things customers often ask
faqs.q1Answer: Terracotta and sand tones naturally hide marks better than light colors. All fabrics have a water-based stain-resistant coating — wipe with a damp cloth and it's clean. Cushion covers are removable and washable.
faqs.q2Answer: Yes. Length, seat depth and armrest height are all customizable to the centimeter. Custom tailoring surcharge is approximately 8–12% of the list price.
faqs.q3Question: How long is the production time?
faqs.q3Answer: In-stock models are delivered within 48h in the city. Custom orders take 18–24 days because the oak frame needs time to stabilize and the back arch is hand-bent.
faqs.q4Question: Can I try it at a showroom?
faqs.q4Answer: Showrooms in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and Da Nang are open 9am–8pm. You can also request the free 40-swatch fabric set delivered to your home.
faqs.q5Answer: Returns within 30 days for manufacturing defects or misdescription. For custom orders, we offer one free reupholstery within the first year.

cta.title: Let your home's sunlight choose the color
cta.subtitle: Receive 40 earth-toned fabric swatches for free, place them by your window and feel. No purchase necessary — we're happy either way.
